In the temporal meaning shown, German wenn translates as Czech “když,” not the interrogative “kdy”.
The current Czech translation duplicates the semantic error by using interrogative “Kdy” for temporal wenn.
The explanation gives the wrong Czech equivalent for repeated or general time; it should say “když”, not “kdy”.
